commands.label: Load the original project and run the compiled VB6 macro with a headless dialog callback

toolchain: VB6 Studio Web 0.6.0 compatible compiler and JS virtual machine
reproduction_command: node verify-vb6.mjs <VB6 Studio Web checkout file URL>
semantic_scope: The published compatible tool read the original VBP and BAS, compiled the project and invoked its declared Sub Main. The virtual machine passed the exact greeting to the headless MsgBox callback.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
